licence: Photos: Pexels License (https://www.pexels.com/license/), downloaded from the Pexels CDN at 1600 px wide. repo_file entries are Padly outputs made from Pexels photos (public/examples/CREDITS.md). Derived entries are deterministic edits of other entries (fetch.py).

tiers.EASY: clean studio or plain background, strong contrast, one clear product
tiers.MEDIUM: room or furniture scenes, cast shadows, product and background of similar colour, several products, props
tiers.HARD: transparent/glass, jewelry and thin parts, fur/hair, white-on-white, product cut by the photo edge, complex reflections, watermark over the product, busy lifestyle scenes, on-model, low light

expected_no_change_rule: true only when the photo already meets the request as is: aspect 1:1 (within 1%), background pure white (border >= 250 in every channel), product bbox centred (within 1% of the side) with 8% (+-1.5%) margin on its limiting axis and at least that on the other.
